mapper.insert: insert into picture (cover_pictures, title, introduce, user_name, category, width, height, size, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) values (#{picture.coverPictures}, #{picture.title}, #{picture.introduce}, #{picture.userName}, #{picture.category}, #{picture.width}, #{picture.height}, #{picture.size}, #{picture.createTime}, #{picture.updateTime}, #{picture.isDeleted})
mapper.update: update picture set cover_pictures = #{picture.coverPictures}, title = #{picture.title}, introduce = #{picture.introduce}, user_name = #{picture.userName}, category = #{picture.category}, width = #{picture.width}, height = #{picture.height}, size = #{picture.size}, update_time = #{picture.updateTime} where id = #{picture.id}
